city-council.title: City Council Meeting
city-council.location: Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, 1650 E Stagecoach Run

agenda.title: DISCUSSION AND INFORMATION ITEMS
agenda.note: This is an opportunity to provide information to the City Council. These items are for information only and do not require action by the City Council.

items.title: Eagle Square Commercial Sign (anticipate time 15 minutes)
items.plain: The council will discuss a commercial sign for Eagle Square.

items.title: Home Business Standards
items.plain: The council will discuss the city's rules for businesses run out of a home.

items.title: Community Garden Presentation
items.plain: The council will hear a presentation about a community garden.

items.title: Utah Wellbeing Project Survey Results
items.plain: The council will hear the results of the Utah Wellbeing Project survey.

items.title: Annual Community Survey
items.plain: The council will discuss the city's yearly survey of residents.

agenda.title: AGENDA REVIEW
agenda.note: The City Council will review items on the Consent Agenda and Policy Session Agenda.

agenda.title: CITY MANAGER INFORMATION ITEMS
agenda.note: This is an opportunity for the City Manager to provide information to the City Council.

agenda.title: ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
agenda.note: The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

agenda.title: PUBLIC COMMENTS
agenda.note: Time has been set aside for the public to express their ideas, concerns, and comments. (Please limit your comments to three minutes each.)

agenda.title: CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR ITEMS
agenda.note: Time has been set aside for the City Council and Mayor to make comments.

items.title: White Hills 4MG Tank Change Order #3 - Final True-up Costs
items.plain: The council will consider a final change order settling the leftover costs on the White Hills 4-million-gallon water tank.

items.title: August 18, 2026 Minutes - Regular City Council Meeting
August 26, 2026 Minutes - City Council Meeting - Special Session
Gateway Park Phase 3
items.plain: The council will consider the preliminary plat, the first-stage lot layout, for phase 3 of Gateway Park.

items.title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Second Amendment to the Brylee Farms Phase B Development Agreement
items.plain: The council will consider a second change to the development agreement for phase B of Brylee Farms.

items.title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, to Become an Official Member of the North Utah County Aquifer Council (NUCAC)
items.plain: The council will decide whether the city should join the North Utah County Aquifer Council, a groundwater group.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 2.45.010 regarding Youth Council Member Term Limits
items.plain: The council will consider changing the city code's limits on how long Youth Council members can serve.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 3.30 regarding Land Disposals
items.plain: The council will consider changing the city code's rules for selling or otherwise disposing of city-owned land.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code to Repeal and Replace Section 17.60.130 regarding Retaining Wall Construction Standards
items.background: (Presented by City Engineer, Vince Hogge) Consideration of an amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.130. This amendment adds detailed design requirements for retaining walls, and includes clarification on building permit requirements, field inspections, and allowable retaining wall locations.
items.plain: The council will hold a public hearing on new rules for retaining walls, covering design, permits, inspections and where walls may go.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Pinnacles and Approving the Pinnacles Master Development Plan/Master Development Agreement Amendment
items.background: (Presented by Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs) A request by Andy Flamm for Master Development Plan and Agreement Amendment to change the identification and zoning of three (3) parcels of land (County Assessor Acct./Serial #s 59:034:0191, 59:034:0192 & 59:034:0193) along Aviator Avenue, being 2.48 acres, 6.04 acres and 5.24 acres respectively, all from Commercial Neighborhood to Agriculture and the future land use setting/category from Neighborhood Residential 1 to Ag or Ag/Rural Density 1 or Open Space - Natural as deemed appropriate.
items.plain: The council will hold a public hearing on rezoning three parcels totaling about 13.8 acres on Aviator Avenue from commercial to agricultural.

items.title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Enacting Chapter 3.50 of the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Establishing Property Tax Allocations
items.background: (Presented by Director of Legislative and Strategic Affairs, Evan Berrett) The proposed ordinance enacts Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.50 regarding Property Tax Allocations to direct property tax revenues toward approved public safety expenditures. The chapter also establishes funding requirements and an annual review process to guide future property tax rate considerations.
items.plain: The council will consider a new code chapter steering property tax money to approved public safety spending, with funding rules and a yearly review.

items.title: Legislative Priorities List
items.plain: The council will receive an update on its list of legislative priorities.

agenda.title: CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR'S BUSINESS AND LIAISON REPORTS
agenda.note: This time is set aside for the City Council's and Mayor's comments on City business, and for Councilmembers to report on the boards they are assigned to as liaisons to the City Council.
